text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, Meisho Doto 
defeated T.M. Opera O. With this, the two 
became—rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto's heart fluttered at their new 
relationship, while T.M. Opera O was 
thrilled by the birth of a rival who would 
make her grow even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The change wasn't merely psychological—it 
showed up in their lap times as well. Air 
Shakur grew certain that the two had 
shattered their limits, breaking through 
the ceiling—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this, the battle against the older 
generation became unpredictable. Standing 
on equal footing, the two head toward the 
decisive battle at the Arima Kinen.
